body:
Photographs from the EXCHANGE closing event, held at the University of Dubrovnik, Croatia, on 10 November 2022, presenting Blue Pass as a new Adriatic tourism offer.

The event brought together project partners to share results connecting aquatic biodiversity, natural and cultural heritage, and visitor experiences across Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Montenegro. Blue Pass combined discounted visits to participating attractions with a mobile guide introducing the project’s thematic routes.

The gallery captures the project team, presentations, the mobile application and the final project publication. My contribution included editing Blue Pass EXChAngE – Project publication, a 46-page publication issued by the Institute of Marine Biology, University of Montenegro, in 2022.
